warming and WLD affected microbial community composition, especially in the northern boreal fen.

the response of microbial communities in boreal sedge-fen ecosystems to warming, and how microbial response may be affected by the moisture regime and water level drawdown (WDL).
the effects of climate warming on microbial community structure in northern and southern fen ecosystems, which represent two different biogeochemical zones of boreal peatlands.
